t: Connection Pool Manager - public implementations survey
title: Connection Pool Manager - public implementations survey
definition: Reuses network or database connections where appropriate.
description:
Connection Pool Manager is one of the fundamental capabilities an AI needs to build things on demand: Reuses network or database connections where appropriate. In the real world this capability is delivered by a rich ecosystem of tools, libraries and platforms. This database is the public edition - a fact-checked survey of the real implementations, the real techniques they share, the standards they follow, and laddered drills that teach the capability hands-on.

No single tool owns Connection Pool Manager. Competing implementations emphasize different trade-offs: speed against flexibility, simplicity against power, integration against independence. The implementation spotlights in this database document the notable real ones - what each does, where it excels, and how it serves Connection Pool Manager. Together they map the territory as it actually exists.

Every record carries a runnable demonstration program, because tools are understood by use. Run the demos with node, compare the implementations, practice the drills, and the Connection Pool Manager capability becomes something you can reach for - with full knowledge of which real tool fits which job.

title: TCP/IP - related Connection Pool Manager technology
definition: The internet's packet protocols.
description:
TCP/IP is not itself a Connection Pool Manager, but it belongs in this survey because real Connection Pool Manager work leans on it. The internet's packet protocols.

In a Connection Pool Manager build it shows up when throughput matters more than novelty. The design favors boring reliability over cleverness: well-trodden paths, clear errors, and behavior you can reason about without reading the source. Knowing the surrounding technology is part of knowing the capability - the best Connection Pool Manager practitioners can say exactly where their tool ends and its neighbors begin.

t: Foundation drill - name the inputs, outputs, and contracts of Connection Pool M

Drill (FOUNDATION): name the inputs, outputs, and contracts of Connection Pool Manager from a one-paragraph brief
